title: Acceptable bag organizer to hang on a wall / put in a drawer; it's plastic (NOT WOOD) & lightweight
text:
Acceptable bag organizer to hang on a wall / put in a drawer; it's plastic (NOT WOOD) & lightweight. I was a bit disappointed when I opened this package because this is made of all plastic when I expected this to be made of wood or bamboo based on the look online and the others on the market. Nevertheless, this is an acceptable four-compartment bag organizer with one opening each for quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack bags. The entire unit can be hung on the wall with the three supplied screws and plastic mollies. The holder can also be placed in a drawer that is large enough to hold it.

I inserted all but snack bags into these slots (because I am currently out of the snack-sized bags) and they fit perfectly without the box, of course.

Overall, this is a lightweight organizer that looks a little bit like bamboo and does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in my cabinets. I do wish it were wood, however, or that they at least warn the customer this is plastic. Although there is no price listed, I would not expect to pay more than $12 for this "plastic" plastic bag organizer.
